name: Minnesota Corn & Soybean Storage
tagline: Grain storage for harvested corn and soybeans in Minnesota's agricultural supply chain.
about: Minnesota Corn & Soybean Storage is a student-run firm in the OPMT 375 Supply Lab. We provide storage space for harvested corn and soybeans within Minnesota's agricultural supply chain. We hold grain until it is ready to move to buyers or to another step in the chain, such as a processing facility.
how_to_order: Open an issue in this repository's Issues tab. Include the crop (corn or soybeans), quantity in bushels, the date the grain will arrive, the date you need it released, and where it should go next. We will reply in the same issue.
